I am here in Ntchisi, and this small plot of a quarter hectare I am keeping for beans. My maize fields take most of the fertilizer coupons from FISP, so for the beans I will rely on the little manure from my goats and the nitrogen the beans fix themselves. I will use seed I saved from last season because improved bean seed is costly and hard to find here, and I will weed by hand with my family — no pesticides, no irrigation, we wait for the rains.
